CORRECTION.note: Discovery manifest listed Collier as 'Democratic' based on web search results. He is actually running as an INDEPENDENT. He announced as Independent in November 2025 and did not enter the Democratic primary. The Democratic Lt. Gov nominee is state Rep. Vikki Goodwin — she needs to be added to the pipeline.
